Figure 1:Accuracy–cost trade-offs across reasoning-effort settings on DeepSWE v1.1. Solid lines and circles denote single-model baselines. ForAgentBaton, diamonds denote handoffs to Qwen 3.8 27B and squares denote handoffs to GPT-5.6 Luna; marker colors identify the source model, as listed in the legend. The green dashed line with a light green band connects the empirical Pareto frontier among evaluatedAgentBatonconfigurations, whose effort labels are highlighted.
For example, the purplelabeledMAXdenotes GLM-5.3 atmaxeffort handing off to Qwen 3.8 27B atxhigheffort; the redlabeledHIGHdenotes Kimi K3 athigheffort handing off to GPT-5.6 Luna atmaxeffort.

Figure 2:Overview of one-time model handoff and context transfer. The receiving model inherits the workspace at handoff and continues the task. Execution history is provided either as an inspectable logfile or directly in context.
